def min_swaps_to_transform(n, p, s):
    from collections import defaultdict

    # Create a mapping from value to its position in both permutations
    p_pos = defaultdict(list)
    s_pos = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n):
        p_pos[p[i]].append(i)
        s_pos[s[i]].append(i)

    # Check if the two permutations are essentially the same
    if p_pos == s_pos:
        return 0, []

    # Function to find the minimum number of swaps
    def find_min_swaps(p, s, n):
        swaps = []
        for i in range(n):
            if p[i] != s[i]:
                idx_p = p.index(s[i])
                swaps.append((i + 1, idx_p + 1))
                p[i], p[idx_p] = p[idx_p], p[i]
        return swaps

    # Try swapping each element in p with its corresponding element in s
    swaps = find_min_swaps(p[:], s[:], n)
    return len(swaps), swaps
